inputs.name: security_only
inputs.description: Install security updates only. Set it to false to install every update from the distribution's own repositories.

inputs.name: reboot
inputs.description: When to reboot after updates: "never", or "when-needed" to reboot when an update asks for it, such as a new kernel.

inputs.name: reboot_time
inputs.description: Time of day to reboot, as HH:MM in the host's time zone, when reboot is "when-needed".

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: When the upgrade timer runs, as a systemd OnCalendar expression such as "*-*-* 03:00". When null, the distribution's own schedule.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Packages never to update automatically, by name or glob, such as ["postgresql*"].
